description: DGX SuperPOD — Cluster Overview: fleet node/GPU health at a glance (fleet-scale DGX SuperPOD)

options.content: 🏠 NVIS Home

panels.description: GPUs with a GENUINE throttle bit active — mask 232 = HW Slowdown(8) + SW Thermal(32) + HW Thermal Slowdown(64) + HW Power Brake(128). Deliberately EXCLUDES SW Power Cap(4) and Sync Boost(16), which are normal power-limited operation at default TDP, not faults.
panels.title: GPUs Throttled (HW/Thermal)
Fleet Health — Offenders (issues only, empty = healthy)

targets.expr: (bitmap_and(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}, 4) > 0) and on(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[5m]) > 0) and on(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"} > 50)

panels.description: SW Power Cap column is LOGIC-GATED: it only lights up when the SW-power-cap bit is set AND the GPU is actively losing cycles to power (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION[5m])>0) AND it is doing real work (GPU_UTIL>50). A GPU merely bumping its default TDP while near-idle is normal and is NOT flagged. All other columns are raw throttle bits.
panels.title: GPUs Throttling — active reasons (SW Power Cap = impacting-only)
